values.note: $18 a night for a Rhode Island resident, $36 for a non-resident (Tier 3, no hookups). A second car pass is $12.

fees.source: https://riparks.ri.gov/campgrounds/camping-policies (2026 Tier 3 No Hookups $18 / $36, read 2026-11-11) + ReserveAmerica campground page ('$12 fee for a 2nd Car Pass')

hookups.source: riparks camping-area descriptions: 'Utilities ARE NOT available at this campground', read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: riparks camping-area descriptions (flush toilets in the shower facilities, composting toilets elsewhere; septic dump free for registered campers) + ReserveAmerica services list (Hot Showers, Dump Station), read 2026-11-11

values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 57 RV-capable sites: 45 in the George Washington loop (20-45 ft; 03, 12, 18, 19, 36-40, 42 and 44 are 20 ft, too short for a 23-ft rig; 26 is the one pull-through) and 12 in the New Loop (30-80 ft). Hike-in tent sites in the Angell and Hill loops, two group shelters and four cabins besides.

sites.source: riparks ('74 well-spaced gravel sites suitable for trailers and RV's') + ReserveAmerica site list and per-site details for parkId 253123, read 2026-11-11

values.note: Check-in 1 PM to 10 PM, check-out 11 AM.

booking.source: riparks camping-area descriptions ('Reservations: Book Online') + the ReserveAmerica campground page (check in/out), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Opened Friday April 10 in 2026 (DEM). No closing date was posted when read 2026-11-11.

note:
Recommended in _Where_Should_We_Camp_Next?_ by Stephanie Puglisi
Wooded gravel sites above Bowdish Reservoir in the George Washington Management Area; the reservoir shows through the trees from sites 21, 26 and 27, and the swimming beach (campers only) is a short walk. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $18/$36, no utilities, showers/flush toilets/dump, RA booking and check-in times; 74 RV/trailer sites per riparks (RA lists 57: 45 at 20-45 ft with 11 at 20 ft, 12 New Loop at 30-80 ft), 1 pull-through; 2026 opened April 10. Lakeview confirmed on RA Waterview sites 21, 26, 27 (45-60 m through woods); 'sites directly on Bowdish Reservoir' removed.
